name: lifecycle
description: Nothing is rewritten and nothing is erased. An Assertion's epistemic payload is immutable, so correcting a claim records a new one and supersedes the old; an element that leaves ordinary recall keeps resolving as a reference.

cases.name: correcting a claim is a new Assertion plus supersession, never an edit
an Assertion's stance cannot be rewritten in place
cases.command: UPDATE ?a SET FIELDS { stance: "reject" } WHERE { ?a ASSERTION {} }

cases.name: an archived element leaves ordinary recall
the record of what was claimed survives being questioned
an element referenced by a tuple still resolves after archiving
